name: CENTROID (केन्द्रक) – COMPLETE NOTES
description:
🔺 
Definition:
Triangle ki teenon medians jis point par milti hain,
use Centroid (G) kehte hain.

Centroid = G

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. IMPORTANT PROPERTY

Centroid median ko 2 : 1 ke ratio mein divide karta hai.

Vertex → G : G → Midpoint
      = 2 : 1

Yaad Rakho:

Top se Centroid = 2 Part
Centroid se Base = 1 Part

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

2. MEDIAN KYA HOTI HAI?

Vertex ko opposite side ke midpoint se milane wali line
Median kehlati hai.

Triangle mein total 3 medians hoti hain.

Inhi 3 medians ka intersection point
Centroid hota hai.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

3. DISTANCE FORMULA

Agar median ki length = m ho

Vertex se Centroid tak distance

= 2m/3

Centroid se Midpoint tak distance

= m/3

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

4. COORDINATE GEOMETRY FORMULA

A(x₁,y₁)
B(x₂,y₂)
C(x₃,y₃)

Centroid G

= ((x₁+x₂+x₃)/3 ,
   (y₁+y₂+y₃)/3)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

5. EXAMPLE

A(1,2)
B(4,5)
C(7,8)

G = ((1+4+7)/3 ,
     (2+5+8)/3)

  = (12/3 , 15/3)

  = (4,5)

Answer = (4,5)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

6. MCQ TRICKS

Q. Centroid kis ratio mein median ko divide karta hai?

Ans → 2 : 1

Q. Vertex se Centroid tak kitna part?

Ans → 2 Part

Q. Centroid se Midpoint tak kitna part?

Ans → 1 Part

Q. Triangle ki kitni medians hoti hain?

Ans → 3

Q. Medians ka intersection point?

Ans → Centroid

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

7. YAAD RAKHNE KI LINE

"Median mile teenon yaar,
Centroid baithe beech bazaar,
Do hissa upar, ek hissa neeche,
2:1 ratio yaad rahe hamesha."

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

8. ONE-LINE REVISION

Centroid = Intersection of Medians

Ratio = 2 : 1

Vertex → G = 2/3 Median

G → Midpoint = 1/3 Median

Coordinates of G

= ((x₁+x₂+x₃)/3 ,
   (y₁+y₂+y₃)/3)
